configurable_props.name: beforeDateCreated
configurable_props.label: Before date created
configurable_props.description: Restrict response to lists created before the set date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

configurable_props.name: sinceDateCreated
configurable_props.label: Since date created
configurable_props.description: Restrict results to lists created after the set date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

configurable_props.name: beforeCampaignLastSent
configurable_props.label: Before campaign last sent
configurable_props.description: Restrict results to lists created before the last campaign send date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

configurable_props.name: sinceCampaignLastSent
configurable_props.label: Since campaign last sent
configurable_props.description: Restrict results to lists created after the last campaign send date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

configurable_props.name: email
configurable_props.label: Email
configurable_props.description: Restrict results to lists that include a specific subscriber's email address.

configurable_props.name: sortField
configurable_props.label: Sort field
configurable_props.description: Returns files sorted by the specified field. Possible value: "date_created"

configurable_props.name: sortDir
configurable_props.label: Sort direction
configurable_props.description: Determines the order direction for sorted results. Possible values: ASC or DESC.

configurable_props.name: hasEcommerceStore
configurable_props.label: Has ecommerce store?
configurable_props.description: The unique ID for the list

configurable_props.name: includeTotalContacts
configurable_props.label: Include total contacts
configurable_props.description: Return the total_contacts field in the stats response, which contains an approximate count of all contacts in any state.
